hypothesis: A fresh C69-identical action-only trajectory from the fixed C58b parent with a 30195-step cosine horizon will improve conditioning-safe action metrics from its own s20000 checkpoint to s30195 and then exceed the promoted C69-s20000 policy in fixed paired LIBERO rollout; otherwise insufficient expert exposure is not the remaining bottleneck under this contract.
single_variable: Relative to C69, only the preregistered fresh trajectory length changes from 20000 to 30195 optimizer steps; the cosine horizon is extended to the same endpoint so both trajectories are complete schedules. The causal budget comparison is C72-s20000 versus C72-s30195 inside this one trajectory. Existing C69-s20000 is used only as the external promoted-champion endpoint because its 20000-step scheduler differs from C72-s20000.

effect_preregistration.primary_comparison: C72-s30195 minus C72-s20000 under the same fresh 30195-step schedule
effect_preregistration.offline_gate: No physical-action, gripper macro-F1, visual shuffle sensitivity or wrong-language sensitivity regression beyond the fixed C69 safety tolerance; at least one preregistered action metric must improve without conditioning collapse.
effect_preregistration.promotion_comparison: If the internal gate passes, compare the selected fixed C72 endpoint directly against promoted C69-s20000 using fresh paired LIBERO initial states and the unchanged evaluator.
stop_conditions: Any NaN/nonfinite gradient, restore mismatch, source/data hash drift or action-contract drift.
Conditioning-collapse gate fails at the internal s20000 or s30195 endpoint.
After completed s30195 evaluation, the internal learning curve is saturated or worse; do not extend merely because more steps are available.

decision.rationale: All source/data/action/objective/optimization/evaluation contracts are fixed and the real eight-rank C72 canary passed every mechanical, gradient, no-leak and exact-restore gate. This releases only the preregistered 30195-step training budget; no action or LIBERO effect is yet established.
